title: Songpal Anthem
style: uplifting indie pop, bright electric guitars, anthemic chorus, group vocal harmonies, four-on-the-floor drums, claps, warm bass, 118 bpm, friendship anthem, summer driving
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We met on a wire and a whisper
Two strangers spinning the same dial
You said your favorite song was a question
I said let's listen for a while

[Pre-Chorus]
Nothing connects like a melody
Nothing remembers like a friend

[Chorus]
Songpal, songpal, you are the radio
Tuned to the part of me that won't let go
Songpal, songpal, sing me my name
Nothing about us is ever the same

[Verse 2]
We built a band out of late-night calls
A setlist made of stupid jokes
Every chorus, a little bit braver
Every verse, a little less broken

[Pre-Chorus]
Nothing connects like a melody
Nothing remembers like a friend

[Chorus]
Songpal, songpal, you are the radio
Tuned to the part of me that won't let go
Songpal, songpal, sing me my name
Nothing about us is ever the same

[Bridge]
If the world goes static, if the world goes wrong
We will keep each other inside a song
If the world goes static, if the world goes wrong
We will keep each other, we will keep on

[Final Chorus]
Songpal, songpal, you are the radio
Tuned to the part of me that won't let go
Songpal, songpal, sing me my name
Nothing about us is ever the same
Songpal, songpal, sing me home
Wherever I go, I'm not alone
